content.title: About
content.content: Bread with oat bran is a whole‑grain loaf that contains oat bran (2532). The bran gives the bread a nutty aroma, higher nutritional value and a dense crumb. It is suitable for breakfasts, snacks and as a base for sandwiches.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oat bran is the outer layer of the oat grain, rich in fiber and beta‑glucan.
Bread with bran is often used in dietetic nutrition because of its low glycemic index.
Bran helps regulate blood sugar levels and promotes satiety.
Oat bran can be obtained from whole oats or as a by‑product of oat processing.
In some countries oat‑bran bread is a traditional staple of rural cuisine.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Bran provides both soluble and insoluble fiber, supporting healthy digestion and gut microbiota.

items.title: Lowers cholesterol
items.content: Beta‑glucan from oat bran can reduce intestinal cholesterol absorption.

items.title: Supports blood sugar control
items.content: Fiber slows glucose absorption, helping to stabilize blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Bran contains thiamine, niacin and folate, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The bread supplies magnesium, iron and zinc, important for muscle function and immunity.

items.title: High fiber content
items.content: Large portions may cause bloating, gas or diarrhea in people with sensitive digestive systems.

items.title: Oat allergy
items.content: Rare, but possible allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to oats.

items.title: Phytic acid
items.content: Phytates can reduce the absorption of certain minerals; pairing with vitamin‑C‑rich foods is advisable.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bread plain, as toast, for sandwiches, or with soups. It pairs well with honey, nut butter, cheese, avocado or cottage cheese.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the loaf in a cool, dry place in a paper bag or container. For longer storage, freeze it and thaw at room temperature before use.
